english.title: Expose child under 12 to risk of burning / scalding
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who had attained the age of 16 years and had responsibility for a child aged under 12 years, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD..), allowed that child to be in a room containing

(A)_[an open fire grate]_
(B)_[a heating appliance likely to cause injury to a person by contact therewith]_

not sufficiently protected to guard against the risk of

(C)_[his]_
(D)_[her]_

being burnt or scalded without taking reasonable precautions against that risk, by reason thereof the child

(E)_[was killed]_
(F)_[suffered serious injury]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 11 of the Children and Young Persons Act 1933.
